recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned portrait of a man standing in a courtroom setting, leaning against a wooden jury box. The aesthetic blends formal attire with gritty, distressed typographic elements and ornate graphic flourishes.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm yellow and brown tones contrasting with deep navy velvet
Gritty, scratched typography layered over a formal interior
Central figure anchored by a dark horizontal wooden foreground
Symmetrical background grid of windows balancing the off-center subject
coreInvariants: Courtroom furniture (jury box, wooden chairs) as environmental context
High-contrast lighting on the subject's face and clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-full shot, subject positioned slightly right of center, leaning forward to create depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, heavy wooden jury box in the foreground provides a solid base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large distressed text in the upper left, move down to the subject's face, and follow his arms to the foreground anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Upper right quadrant features a repetitive window grid, providing texture without distracting from the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and sepia tones in the background and lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue of the velvet blazer providing a cool counterpoint.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Stark white used for the distressed typography and trousers.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellows; deep shadows with crushed blacks in the clothing and background corners.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool greens or bright magentas
Maintain a limited palette of gold, navy, white, and mahogany

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of heavy sans-serif and traditional blackletter
letterConstructionRules: Primary text features heavy distressing, resembling scratched paint or worn stone
Secondary text uses a sharp, ornate blackletter style with elongated serifs
Horizontal filigree lines flank the secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the primary text is stylized with a crossbar that extends beyond the stems
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Gritty modern texture paired with traditional gothic formality.
graphicDevices: Heavy border framing the entire composition

preserve: The contrast between the eroded top text and the sharp blackletter bottom text
The white color of the typography

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weathered, scratched aesthetic of the primary name.
Captures the formal, traditional weight of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a navy velvet blazer and yellow sweater leaning on a dark wood jury box in a sepia-toned courtroom with wooden chairs and window grids in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, white, distressed-texture sans-serif text in the top left. Below it, add a smaller line of white blackletter text flanked by ornate filigree flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the color grade consistently warm/sepia?
Does the top text look eroded or scratched?
Is the subject leaning on a dark wooden foreground element?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the sepia color grade
Level of distress on the primary typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brand logos or advisory stickers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text texture doesn't make it unreadable
Check that the navy blazer doesn't disappear into the shadows
Confirm the warm yellow glow is centered on the subject's torso
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban-Gothic Courtroom Aesthetic: Combine a formal interior setting with high-contrast warm lighting, a subject in rich textures (velvet/wool), and a dual-typographic treatment featuring eroded modernism and sharp classical blackletter.
